question: What is the product with the highest valid sales revenue in May 2026?
verification_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM sales_orders AS o JOIN sales_order_items AS i ON o.sales_order_id = i.sales_order_id JOIN products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-06-01' AND o.status IN ('confirmed', 'shipped', 'completed') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 1
notes: Sales revenue is aggregated by order item quantity × unit_price; cancelled orders are excluded.

question: Which products currently have on-hand inventory below their safety stock?
verification_sql: WITH latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.product_id, s.on_hand_quantity FROM inventory_snapshots AS s JOIN (SELECT product_id, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM inventory_snapshots GROUP BY product_id) AS latest ON s.product_id = latest.product_id AND s.snapshot_date = latest.snapshot_date) SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, li.on_hand_quantity, p.safety_stock FROM products AS p JOIN latest_inventory AS li ON p.product_id = li.product_id WHERE li.on_hand_quantity < p.safety_stock ORDER BY p.product_id ASC
notes: Current inventory is selected per product by its latest snapshot; equal to safety stock is not a risk.

question: What is the total valid procurement spend in May 2026?
verification_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_cost) AS effective_purchase_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND order_date < '2026-06-01' AND status IN ('ordered', 'partially_delivered', 'delivered')
notes: Valid procurement spend is summed by valid purchase order quantity × unit_cost.

question: What is the on-time delivery rate for each supplier?
verification_sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(po.purchase_order_id) AS delivered_order_count, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN po.actual_delivery_date <= po.promised_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(po.purchase_order_id), 0), 2) AS on_time_delivery_rate FROM suppliers AS s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id AND po.status = 'delivered' AND po.actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY s.supplier_id ASC
important_filters: cancelled and open purchase orders excluded from denominator
notes: On-time means actual_delivery_date <= promised_delivery_date; rate is NULL when there are no delivered orders.

question: Among suppliers with at least one delivered purchase order, who has the lowest on-time delivery rate?
verification_sql: WITH delivery_rates AS (SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN po.actual_delivery_date <= po.promised_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(po.purchase_order_id), 2) AS on_time_delivery_rate FROM suppliers AS s JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.status = 'delivered' AND po.actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name) SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, on_time_delivery_rate FROM delivery_rates ORDER BY on_time_delivery_rate ASC, supplier_id ASC LIMIT 1
important_filters: requires at least one delivered purchase order
notes: Suppliers without delivered orders are excluded from the comparison.

question: Which product experienced the largest sales volume decline in June 2026 compared to May 2026?
verification_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-06-01' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS may_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS june_quantity FROM sales_orders AS o JOIN sales_order_items AS i ON o.sales_order_id = i.sales_order_id WHERE o.status IN ('confirmed', 'shipped', 'completed') GROUP BY i.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, m.may_quantity, m.june_quantity, m.may_quantity - m.june_quantity AS quantity_decline FROM monthly_sales AS m JOIN products AS p ON m.product_id = p.product_id WHERE m.may_quantity > m.june_quantity ORDER BY quantity_decline DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 1
notes: Sales volume is summed by item quantity; only products with an actual decline are compared.

question: Which purchase orders have been placed but not yet delivered?
verification_sql: SELECT po.purchase_order_number, s.supplier_name, p.product_name, po.status, po.promised_delivery_date FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN suppliers AS s ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id JOIN products AS p ON po.product_id = p.product_id WHERE po.status IN ('ordered', 'partially_delivered') AND po.actual_delivery_date IS NULL ORDER BY po.purchase_order_number ASC
notes: Not yet delivered excludes cancelled or delivered orders.

question: What are the combined sales revenue and inventory risk results for the Sensors category in Q2 2026?
verification_sql: WITH category_sales AS (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS quarter_sales_amount FROM sales_orders AS o JOIN sales_order_items AS i ON o.sales_order_id = i.sales_order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' AND o.status IN ('confirmed', 'shipped', 'completed') GROUP BY i.product_id), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.product_id, s.on_hand_quantity FROM inventory_snapshots AS s JOIN (SELECT product_id, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM inventory_snapshots GROUP BY product_id) AS latest ON s.product_id = latest.product_id AND s.snapshot_date = latest.snapshot_date) SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, cs.quarter_sales_amount, li.on_hand_quantity, p.safety_stock, CASE WHEN li.on_hand_quantity < p.safety_stock THEN 'low_stock' ELSE 'normal' END AS inventory_risk FROM products AS p JOIN category_sales AS cs ON p.product_id = cs.product_id JOIN latest_inventory AS li ON p.product_id = li.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Sensors' ORDER BY p.product_id ASC
notes: Sales revenue and inventory risk are calculated under unified rules before combined presentation.
